parameters.text: [curious] No added sugar. Sounds like sugar-free... right? [long-break] [doubtful] Well... not quite. [break] Fruit juice can still contain sugar from the fruit. [confident] So turn the pack over. Check total sugars, then compare similar drinks per hundred millilitres. [warm] Small flip. Better information.
